note: WAEC Civic round 7 (R39 top-up): empathy; gratitude; patriotism; orderliness; calm queues; the zebra crossing; the driver's licence; direct democracy; Lincoln's definition; rule of law; citizenship defined; citizenship by registration; NYSC as national service; government's duty of amenities; youth empowerment; skills acquisition; the peer group; mass media and school as agents of socialisation; community service; the national motto; the pledge's aim; citizenship education's objective; limits of rights; the purpose of laws; consequences of ignoring traffic rules. Scanned against the whole Civic pool (WAEC and NECO stems).
